title: Earth Has More Trees Than the Milky Way Has Stars
description: Scientists estimate there are about three trillion trees on Earth, far more than the stars in our galaxy.

scenes.text: There are more trees on Earth than stars in our galaxy.
scenes.subject: forest
scenes.say: [excited] There are more trees on Earth... than stars in our galaxy.

scenes.text: A large study estimated there are about three trillion trees on our planet.
scenes.subject: forest
scenes.say: A large study estimated there are about THREE TRILLION trees on our planet.

scenes.text: The Milky Way is thought to have somewhere between one hundred and four hundred billion stars.
scenes.subject: galaxy
scenes.say: The Milky Way is thought to have somewhere between one hundred and four hundred billion stars.

scenes.text: The same study found that billions of trees are cut down every year, so that number keeps shrinking.
scenes.say: [sighs] [sad] The same study found that billions of trees are cut down every year, so that number keeps shrinking.

scenes.text: Every one of those trees counts. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.say: [warmly] Every one of those trees counts. Follow for more weird facts.
